sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:sparql/sh:select applicability UNION branches: The first exemption branch treats any non-IA/IA iceClass value as sufficient to exempt the ship. A ship having both an applicable value (IA or IA Super) and a non-applicable value can therefore bypass the mandatory compliance and deadline checks. Required change: Make the applicability test require that no applicable IA or IA Super value exists, or otherwise enforce a single authoritative iceClass before applying the exemption logic.

[WRONG_APPLICABILITY] MainShape/sh:sparql/sh:select/outer FILTER NOT EXISTS/first UNION branch: The first UNION branch matches whenever the ship does not have iceClass IA Super or IA, so the outer FILTER NOT EXISTS reports a violation for non-applicable ships instead of excluding them from the requirement. Required change: Move the IA Super/IA test into a positive applicability scope and evaluate the construction-date, method, and deadline conditions only within that scope; non-IA Super/IA ships must produce no violation from this constraint. | [WRONG_APPLICABILITY] MainShape/sh:sparql/sh:select/outer FILTER NOT EXISTS/second UNION branch: The second UNION branch matches every ship with constructionStageDate on or after 1 September 2003 because it does not restrict ?iceClass to IA Super or IA, and the outer structure treats that match as a reason not to validate the requirement, causing applicable and non-applicable later-constructed ships to fail. Required change: Remove this branch as an independent match and make the construction-date cutoff a positive prerequisite within the IA Super/IA applicability condition; ships at or after 1 September 2003 must be outside this rule.
